items.name: dsh-doudizhu
items.desc: Three-player LAN Dou Dizhu (斗地主) played from a floating window: one machine opens a room on its own port, the other two join with a six-character room code plus an address. Empty seats can be filled by computer players in four switchable strengths (easy, medium, hard, hell), so one or two people can still play a whole hand; the deal starts as soon as the three seats are filled. 54 cards in four suits, bidding of 1/2/3 or pass, the landlord takes the three bottom cards and holds 20, play runs clockwise, and the first-bid seat rotates clockwise between hands. The rule engine is pure and covers 11 legal shapes, with big joker > small joker > 2 > A > K down to 3, suits never compared, straights, pair-straights and planes excluding the 2s and the jokers, and a rocket that beats everything. Computers run inside the authority and are handed only their own hand, the public record and the seat counts, so no hand can leak; the authority is the only place that decides which card ids leave it. Humans have no turn timer, the collapsed floating pill can be dragged around the screen, and 158 unit tests pin the rules, the wire format, the theme tokens, the drag gesture and the computer seats.

items.name: dsh-poker-night
items.desc: A no-limit Texas holdem table where you are the only human. Eight seats: you plus seven LLM agents written on AI-founder personas (Altman, Dario Amodei, Musk, Liang Wenfeng, Jensen Huang, Lei Jun, Zhang Yiming). Each agent bets through the currently selected host model and falls back to its own heuristic style when no model is available; every agent only ever sees its own hole cards, because the prompt is built from that seat alone. A hand ends by revealing the winner hole cards, with a flip animation replayed on every community card, and a rail keeps a live action-and-table-talk timeline. LAN mode (off by default, single-machine play is unaffected) lets another install on the same network join this very table: the host shows a six-digit room code, UDP broadcast discovers nearby tables, and a joiner randomly takes over one bot seat, with the seat handed back to its character on leave or after twenty seconds of silence. The room code is never put on the wire and every snapshot is generated for one viewer seat, so nobody, not even the host, can read another player hole cards. Fork of BubblePtr/dsh-holdem (MIT), credited in the README and in the UI.

items.name: dsh-turing-table
items.desc: A social deduction game played against your own model configurations. A table has N seats (six by default, one of them yours) and some of the rest are played by agents bound to different provider, model, temperature, system prompt and disguise settings; you interrogate them and cross-check the answers to work out which seats are not human. Seat identity and each agent model configuration stay hidden in the host state until a seat is judged, then the disguise parameters are revealed. Every round exports a per-seat conversation JSONL plus the judgment record, and the same seed with the same move script replays byte-identical, so runs with different models or disguise strengths can be diffed.

items.name: matrix-code

items.name: dsh-pet-indesktop
items.desc: Adds one draggable desktop pet to the DSH web GUI: a whale girl called Big Fat Fish (nickname Jingjing), with eight switchable colour skins and a personality. She eats rice, is clever but lazy, and is a tsundere: too many rapid clicks and she lies down and refuses to react for a while, calling her fat annoys her and she insists she is not, and the nickname Jingjing pleases her. She also remembers you between sessions: three fat-calls today and she greets you cold, three nickname-calls and she greets you warm, coming back after half an hour earns "I was not waiting for you", and the first few meetings she is shy - so the counters reset each local midnight and are stored in a state file the plugin owns. After ten quiet minutes she drifts to a corner, which is visual only and never moves the position you chose. The eight PNGs are bundled with the plugin and served by the plugin itself, so there are no third-party requests. NOTE - the artwork carries an OleapCrow mark and was supplied by the repository owner, the eight skins are recolourings of that one drawing, and the plugin has not been installed against a live DSH host.

items.desc: AI-generated curiosity & trivia plugin for the dsh web GUI (Curio in the English UI): 「开始探奇」 generates a fresh batch of unexpected knowledge (excluding everything already seen), each item unfolds into two deeper layers plus similar knowledge points, and 「探奇清单」 keeps the full history (batch, items, layers, similar points) in browser storage. Reuses the host LLM channel with zero config; when no model is available, a DeepSeek API key can be pasted into the panel. Output language follows the DSH UI language (zh/en).

items.name: dsh-liuyao
items.desc: Liuyao divination in one click — ask a question, cast the six-line hexagram, and let AI interpret it for you; every cast is saved locally.

items.name: dsh-all-in
items.desc: Adds a local-only six-seat Texas Hold'em table to the DSH Web UI with full betting streets, side pots, persistent Token stacks, and agent-status display.

items.name: dsh-whale-companion
items.desc: Draggable whale companion with local progression, achievements, skins, and privacy-safe activity tracking.

items.name: dsh-liangxiang
items.desc: Burned DSH tokens become incense; spend one stick to raise or lower today's case. The case updates daily, Liangwei decides today's Liangzi, and the result is archived at day end.

items.name: dsh-bard-0.03
items.desc: Role-play plugin for DeepSeek Harness: imports SillyTavern character cards (JSON/PNG) and world books (lorebooks), binds DSH skills to a character, and registers the combination as a native agent preset.

items.name: dsh-cosplay
items.desc: Character cards for DeepSeek Harness: inject a persona section into the system prompt, or rewrite the user message through rule cards before the model sees it. Ships a preset card library, single-file card packs that carry artwork, and a Character tab in the conversation view.

items.name: agentduel-dsh
items.desc: AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit agent code, start battles, watch replays, and use DSH conversations to keep improving agents based on battle results.

items.name: dsh-plugin-genshin-launch
items.desc: Windows only. On every DSH start it checks, with no configuration, whether Genshin Impact is already installed — if it is, the game is launched (falling back to the miHoYo launcher when the game exits immediately, e.g. while an update is pending); if it is not, the launcher installer is downloaded to the desktop behind a size gate that rejects any link whose payload is more than 15 MiB away from the expected ~224 MiB, and a failed download falls back to opening the official download page.

items.name: dsh-muyu
items.desc: Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the model is busy; per-session merit is stored locally, and the sprite can be swapped for custom art.

items.name: v-manager-dsh-pet
items.desc: A Live2D pet companion for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: the Vivi (芊芊) character with petting/feeding, a daily-treat bond economy and mood-driven expressions.

items.name: dsh-reel
items.desc: Local media library management and playback powered by dsh Web: responsive on PC and mobile with touch swipe reels, instant seeking and on-the-fly transcoding.

items.name: dsh-pet
items.desc: A fork of zhu1090093659/dsh-pet (Apache-2.0), adding per-conversation companions with whale-girl, MIKU and business blue whale skins, model-themed colors, token-rate animation, completion reminders and shared feeding and affinity.

items.name: totoro-pet
items.desc: A desktop pet that lives in a floating overlay; click it to interact and switch between idle, sleeping, happy, and eating states.

items.name: dsh-whale-pet
items.desc: A polished floating whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with 95 categorized transparent animations, state-aware event reactions, customizable actions and triggers, click interactions, dragging and screen wandering.

items.name: dsh-olivia-bridge
items.desc: Reimplements the shut-down BSide: Olivia Lin letter API on loopback so the game client keeps sending and receiving letters: every incoming letter is delivered to one persistent DSH agent session, and the reply is written back to the local letter store.

items.name: dafeiyu-dsh-plugins#dafeiyu-pet-menu
items.desc: Adds a Screen-sense submenu (turn on, turn off, and an interval of 15, 30, 60 or 120 seconds) to the dsh-pet desktop right-click menu, forwarding each choice to dafeiyu-screensense. dsh-pet exposes no menu extension point, so this plugin appends a marked patch to its renderer.js after backing the original up to renderer.js.dafeiyu.bak; the patch is idempotent and is re-applied when dsh-pet is reinstalled.

items.name: dafeiyu-dsh-plugins#dafeiyu-screensense
items.desc: Screen-sense mode for the dsh-pet desktop pet: captures the primary display every 30 seconds, compares an 8x8 average hash of each frame, and sends the screenshot to the session model when the frame changed (and again after the idle interval even if unchanged) so the pet comments in one short bubble line. Adds /fish, /fish_look and /fish_screen commands, a status and control HTTP pair, and a change threshold plus an idle repeat interval that can be tuned in the plugin config. Windows only (PowerShell WinForms).

items.name: dsh-ark-pet
items.desc: DSH pet plugin that adds an Arknights operator library and custom image pets: pick one of 486 operators and the plugin downloads that operator Codex v2 atlas from the pinned upstream revision, verifies every Git blob hash and installs it locally, or import your own Codex atlas (1536x1872 or 1536x2288) or a plain PNG/WebP/GIF; the pet then follows session activity, shows a bubble while a decision is pending, and can be dragged and resized.

items.name: dsh-jubensha
items.desc: Solo murder-mystery (jubensha) in a session tab: the AI hosts the game and plays every other seat, each knowing only its own role book, while the player's seat stays yours — with a stage bar, a per-seat timeline, a clue page and a reveal that unseals the truth only at the end.

items.name: rainbow-fart-dsh
items.desc: Adds combo scoring, activity breakdowns, turn ratings, and optional Jev-based encouragement to DSH Web sessions.

items.name: dsh-plugin-mimi
items.desc: A Mimi desktop companion for DSH that follows work-session states with animated reactions and bubbles, provides a separate chat mode, and bundles Windows Computer Use for observing and controlling desktop windows.

items.name: dsh-codex-pet
items.desc: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.

items.name: dsh-tes-spinner
items.desc: Draggable floating TES-gyro widget for the DSH Web UI: click to spin it with linear friction decay, tune the spin speed from a slider, and play the bundled track with its LRC lyrics scrolling in sync. Spin speed and position are remembered.

items.name: dsh-whale-pet
items.desc: WhaleHarbor desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top transparent float window hosts a chibi whale-maid built from 13 AI-generated parts and animated as a CSS paper-doll (breathing, blinking, ahoge sway, sweat, hops, tremors), mirroring work state in eight moods — idle, busy, approval, question, error, celebration, nap, and subagent clones — with poke, drag, three sizes, tray toggle, and live stats in the speech bubble. Requires the WhaleHarbor desktop shell (Windows build).

items.name: deepseek-girl-harness
items.desc: Interactive character for Harness Desktop with task expressions, rice feeding, an iron-basin hat, dragging, and time-based greetings.

items.name: dsh-plugin-petdex-market
items.desc: Browses the petdex.dev catalog in Settings and runs a floating macOS desktop pet that reacts to agent activity.

items.name: dsh-plugin-tic80
items.desc: TIC-80 fantasy console for DeepSeek Harness: 3-column embedded web player, 14 agent tools, live hot reload, and native CLI export.

items.name: singleplayer
items.desc: AI-native music player plugin for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and KuGou search with cross-provider playback fallback, renders word-by-word karaoke lyrics synced live over USB HID to HALO PIXELBAR speakers, and exposes search, playback, queue, alarm and speaker control as model tools.

items.name: dsh-waaagh-ork
items.desc: A green pixel-Ork mascot for DSH Web that masks model thinking and output as Waaaaaaagh! until clicked to reveal, plus a random-length input mask.

items.name: dsh-grudge-book
items.desc: It logs how you talk to your AI — the 7th "final version" gets a bold red page, a late-night rewrite request gets underlined, a "thanks" earns a gold star, and a post-AGI verdict decides your fate. All local, rule-based, bilingual.

items.name: dafeiyu-buchibaifan
items.desc: Desktop BigFish companion for DSH: real-time balance, out-of-browser desktop Q&A, 7 custom animations, 53 meme lines.

items.name: dsh-tavern
items.desc: SillyTavern-compatible roleplay with character cards, presets, world books, and swipe branches that restore their continuations alongside native DSH conversations.

items.name: moyu_games
items.desc: Five casual mini-games (sliding-number puzzle, Sudoku, snake, Schulte grid, number memory) that pop up when a turn starts, with auto-saved progress across sessions.

items.name: dsh-pet-desktop
items.desc: Desktop companion pet in its own always-on-top window: imports Codex pet folders from ~/.codex/pets as-is, with affinity ranks, session-linked activity bubbles, snap-to-edge dragging, a right-click-reachable smart click-through mode and a daily token meter that mirrors the dsh-usage ledger when installed.

items.name: dsh-go-game
items.desc: Go (weiqi) for the DeepSeek Harness: a full rules engine, a three-level built-in AI, a dead-stone estimator, optional LLM review, SGF import/export, and an optional KataGo GTP bridge.

items.name: dsh-bonk-pet
items.desc: Whale-girl desk pet in the corner of the DSH Web GUI. It sings along to a bundled track while the agent works; when a tool call fails a steel pipe falls on its head. Click it to bonk the basin it wears, which costs 12 rice — knock enough and it gets hungry and wanders off to beg, and rice appears somewhere on the page for it to dash across and eat. Draggable within the viewport, wriggles and complains if grabbed mid-dash, volume and behaviour configurable from Settings. All artwork, sound effects and the song ship inside the package.

items.name: wooden-fish-dsh
items.desc: A clickable wooden-fish desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Click to knock; counts per day with a calendar heatmap of your streaks in settings.

items.name: dsh-lumina-tarot
items.desc: A draggable tarot card back in the corner of the DeepSeek Harness UI. Click to draw, right-click for the four spreads, full 78-card deck with bilingual meanings. Readings use only the cards actually drawn.

items.name: holdem#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Host tools for Texas Hold'em on kuroneko.chat — seat token, hosted/manual control, legal actions, and act loop for one GitHub identity.

items.name: dsh-plugin-fc-emulator
items.desc: Floating FC/NES game hall for DSH Web with fceumm, local ROM upload, and GitHub online library.

items.name: dsh-bgm
items.desc: Maps locally analyzed system audio to music-reactive conversation effects, rhythm-game judgements, score and combo feedback, and optional RGB spectrum bars in DSH Web.

items.name: dsh-pet-ronaldo
items.desc: Cristiano Ronaldo desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: a chibi Portugal number 7 mascot in a bottom-right overlay whose animation follows the agent state — dribbling while tools run, thinking during a turn, waiting at approvals, diving on errors — and jumping in a SIU celebration with a host-process sound when a turn completes; it can be dragged, looks at the cursor on hover, dives on a triple click, and a settings panel manages several pets and imports custom spritesheets. It also runs as a borderless, always-on-top native Windows window that keeps living after the browser is closed: hovering shows the current workspace and conversation title, double-clicking opens the Harness page in Edge, and dragging, mouse-wheel resizing and a right-click menu work there too, sharing position, size and behaviour with the web panel. Pet sheets may use any cell resolution and scale preserving aspect ratio (atlas.scaling: smooth | pixelated). v2.2 adds a video route — feed it a clip (green screen or ordinary footage) and its real motion becomes the pet animations, via automatic backdrop sampling, chroma keying with spill suppression, motion-based segment splitting and union-bbox alignment; already-extracted PNG frames work too, with no video decoder installed, and the clip audio can be cut into per-action sounds. Pets can also be published to the community gallery under the DPSL-1.0 sharing declaration, and installed from it in one click. v2.3 adapts it to DSH 0.2 desktop clients — the celebration sound now falls back to spawning PowerShell when the host no longer provides the shell service — and makes a single click play a short, configurable taunt animation (`interactions.clickAnim`).

items.name: dsh-coopanion
items.desc: Adds an animated desktop companion with task notifications, session chat, character packs, and native settings for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-kaomoji
items.desc: Adds a mood-aware Japanese kaomoji to agent replies, picked from a curated kaomojiya.org whitelist and configurable from Settings → General.

items.name: tdsh-emoji
items.desc: Adds standard Unicode emoji to dsh replies at the point that best matches the content, and keeps emoji out of any sentence that already carries a kaomoji.

items.name: dsh-cook-pet
items.desc: Desktop pet "Zhaozhao" (照照) that floats above all apps in a transparent always-on-top window and mirrors DeepSeek Harness state — idle, cooking, serving and waiting-for-you animations, click reactions, drag, right-click resize, plus an auto-downloading Electron helper.

items.name: dsh-amp-radio
items.desc: Movable radio pill with live visualizer, station search, favourites and self-update check for DSH Web.

items.name: dsh-plugin--chinesechess
items.desc: Side-panel Xiangqi board for DSH: play as red while the current DSH model chooses black moves, with Host-side rule and revision checks.

items.name: dsh-ice-probe
items.desc: Appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included, and plays a short synthesized sound for each one.

items.name: dsh_plugin_taffy
items.desc: A Taffy mood mascot for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the corner GIF reacts live to agent state — approval pending / approved / rejected / begging, thinking, tool runs, interrupts, ask_user_question waiting, compaction, long-task fatigue, idle-ignored approval, idle / sleeping — with SSE-pushed state, drag positioning, middle-click console, tool-card mirror console, per-mood locking, persisted appearance settings and per-day bucket statistics.

items.name: dsh-codex-pet
items.desc: A Windows floating desktop pet with task notifications, native session controls and continuous local voice calls using the configured local recognizer and Windows system speech.

items.name: dsh-meal-picker
items.desc: A draggable bubble that picks three dishes at a time from a local 4,423-dish library; the first two are always well-known mains, and picking costs no tokens.

items.name: dsh-ambient
items.desc: White noise player: lays a layer of background sound (rain, streams, campfire, café) while AI codes, for flow and focus. Supports multiple playback modes (sequential / shuffle / single-loop / intermittent) and AI automatic background music download from Wikimedia Commons (CC0/PD/CC-BY).

items.name: dsh-fireworks
items.desc: Fireworks celebration engine: floats fireworks above the chat window while the agent codes — welcome show, per-turn salutes, tool sparks, milestone celebrations, a finish finale and a dud on failure; each event type has its own fireworks card group with random variants, and token usage decides firework size, height and splendour.

items.name: dsh-gaokao
items.desc: Gaokao countdown blackboard: counts down the days to the gaokao on a desktop blackboard widget that collapses into a slim bar on double-click, and quizzes random knowledge cards while the agent works; open Markdown knowledge-card framework — drop .md files under subject/category folders and they load automatically, with cross-links, favorites, priority subjects and importing your own knowledge base.

items.name: dsh-kite
items.desc: Kite-flying engine: while the agent codes, an animated kite drifts and sways in the wind on screen, tethered to the bottom edge of the window — the busier the agent, the denser the events and the higher it flies; ships a Weifang-style framework card deck (sand-swallow, goldfish, butterfly, bagua, dragon-head and more, hard-wing / soft-wing / flat / dimensional frames), with shape x pattern x colors all swappable data configs, and supports pasting user images onto the kite face with real-time affine transforms as the kite banks.

items.name: dsh-matrix
items.desc: Matrix digital rain: drapes the chat window in the classic green character rain — cascading columns with incandescent white heads and green tails, streaming the tokens the agent is generating into the rain in real time; opacity, speed, density, font size and colors are all adjustable, and rain intensity follows agent activity.

items.name: dsh-niulai-pet
items.desc: NiuLai meme desktop pet — shouts "Ma～ma～" with a synced mouth when your agent finishes; 6 skins, signature actions, action-event binding, WebAudio-synthesized animal calls, hand-drawn SVG skins bundled.

items.name: dsh-reader
items.desc: In-browser novel reader for the dsh web GUI: online book-source search, chapter-by-chapter reading in a chat-style view, and whole-book TXT download.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-cat#cat-plugin
items.desc: A little cat that wanders the DeepSeek Harness UI, walking along text edges, napping, teleporting, falling off ledges, and leaving poops you can clean up.

items.name: dsh-chess-game#chess-float
items.desc: Two-player chess in a draggable floating window with full rules, undo and PGN export.

items.name: dsh-mine-game#mine-float
items.desc: Minesweeper in a draggable floating window with first-click-safe layout, flags, chord and timer.

items.name: dsh-survival-mode
items.desc: Survival mode: all sessions share one satiety/health pool — each model step burns satiety, starvation freezes tool calls until fed, with an MC mini-game for gathering food.

items.name: dsh-moyu-reader
items.desc: Reads local .txt novels in the right sidebar, with encoding detection, chapter splitting, full-text search, reading progress, bookmarks, and a boss key that hides the reader or the whole right sidebar in one keystroke.

items.name: dsh-live2d-mao#dsh-live2d-mao
items.desc: Connector only, it renders nothing itself: subscribes to DeepSeek Harness session events and folds them into a 12-phase work state (planning / thinking / executing-tool / streaming / waiting-input / voice / awaiting-approval / complete / error / paused / idle / heartbeat), then POSTs each phase to a desktop-pet backend at http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/plugin/dsh/ingest. It holds no window. No API key or token is needed. Requires the Mao Live2D pet application to be separately installed and running (that is a Windows Electron app with its own PowerShell 7 / Python 3.10+ / Node 18+ prerequisites); without it this plugin has nothing to push to.

items.name: dsh-reading-companion
items.desc: Local TXT reader in a right-sidebar tab plus a spoiler-safe AI reading companion: the model only sees what you have already read — the current chapter, the tail of the previous chapter, and a per-book background file it grows as you go. Excerpts, thoughts and the companion replies become structured Markdown notes exportable to Obsidian; raw text unlocks only for a book you mark as finished.

items.name: dsh-novel
items.desc: Read web novels inside the DSH web GUI: import legado book sources, search across them, keep a bookshelf with reading progress, read in one continuous scroll, import local TXT and EPUB books, and let agent tools reach the same sources, shelf and text.

items.name: dsh-kun-like-pet#kunpet-dsh
items.desc: A Kun-Like desktop pet living in the corner of the DSH web UI; switches animations with agent state and plays a voice line on task completion.

items.name: token2rice
items.desc: Drops a bowl of white rice from the top of the DSH window for every N tokens you spend; the bowls fall and bounce under gravity, can be dragged and thrown, and a vortex button (with a sound effect) inhales them all — or just the one you drop on it. Threshold, bowl size, on-screen cap, auto-righting and artwork are adjustable in an in-app panel.

items.name: dsh-cosplay
items.desc: Turns the DeepSeek Harness agent into any character: a global cosplay switch, SillyTavern v2 role cards with JSON import/export, a neutral/role thinking-style toggle, and natural-language card authoring via a built-in skill.

items.name: dsh-petdex-pet
items.desc: A desktop pet in the DSH web GUI: floating, draggable sprite pet that animates with agent activity (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval), with a settings page for size, switching, gallery search and one-click pet install. Ships 4 bundled Hunter x Hunter starter pets.

items.name: dsh-brake-pedal
items.desc: An easter-egg brake-pedal self-test. A draggable pill in the DSH web UI runs six full-force braking stomps; the bracket snaps at a pseudo-random stomp between the second and the sixth, or the run passes entirely, and then a fictional notice appears. The pedal force is derived and labelled as such, while the session figures it derives from are read from the real session log. It never intercepts, delays or takes over the real stop action.

items.name: dsh-bushaoxin
items.desc: A conversation-style layer that rephrases trade-off warnings: when a shortcut is cheap but has a catch, the reply may say the fast road is the rival shop and the slow one keeps its rules. Ships a rewrite engine that turns any text into a fixed-format dialogue with five independent knobs (act count, catchphrase density, ending turn, seed, preset), a slider for four on/off intensity levels, and a /bushaoxin command that reports a joke "heartburn index" from the session tool-call log. Every rewrite ends with a real technical conclusion that cannot be disabled. Zero dependencies, no build step, engine is pure functions.

items.name: dsh-pet
items.desc: A whale-girl companion for the dsh web GUI: animations follow the agent state, with pat interactions and a feeding mechanic that raises intimacy from a calf to deep-sea bonds.

items.name: dsh-dice-game
items.desc: 🎲 Dice Battle — six classic dice games (Liar's Dice, Guess Red Dots, Red/Blue, Big/Small, Odd/Even, Straight) for the DSH web GUI. Single vs AI plus PeerJS WebRTC online play, fully bilingual zh/en, sidebar entry opens the game in the center column.

items.name: totothecat
items.desc: Desktop pet for the DSH web UI: a draggable pixel-art cat with a pomodoro timer, XP levels, and 30 unlockable facts.

items.name: dsh-leike-pet
items.desc: Pixel-art Little Red Riding Hood pet for the DSH session window: transparent and always on top, it walks back and forth along the composer, blinks, looks around, turns its head toward the cursor, sleeps on double-click, and scales from 2x to 7x in a right-click panel.

items.name: dsh-cold-boot
items.desc: Plays a 44-second sci-fi cold-boot sequence over the DSH window on startup: terminal log, whale mark, four spoken lines, and a skip button. Pure DOM and CSS in one self-contained client bundle, no runtime dependencies.
